good: Strong speed sense: boost has blur, speed lines and FOV kick, and reaches 300+ km/h
Varied track with a city canyon, a palm and hill section and a long lit tunnel
Clean Burnout-style HUD showing position, lap and time, takedowns, a two-colour boost bar and big speed numbers
bad: Walls are not forgiving: the scripted drive gets CRASHED again and again from side and wall scrapes, especially in the tunnel
The S phase never clearly shows the car reversing; speed stays at about 44-58
Takedowns show only a small 'wrecked +boost' text; neither video shows a big takedown card or slow motion
opus-5.5-xhigh.one_line: It looks fast and the boost really hits, but you crash on almost every wall scrape and the takedowns feel weak.

good: Strong speed sense: boost blur, speed lines, FOV push and a tunnel at 300 km/h
Drift smoke and skid marks work. Takedown and near-miss text appear in the trailer.
The city, hills and tunnel give the track variety, and the Burnout-style HUD is clear.
bad: The scripted drive crashes and walls out constantly, so the road is hard to hold.
The scenery is low-poly and flat, and the blocky car is generic.
The takedown card is hard to read in the footage, and rivals are rarely visible during play.
sonnet-5.5-xhigh.one_line: It looks and sounds fast with a good boost and tunnel, but it crashes too easily and feels more like a rough prototype than Burnout 3.
